items.statement: Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-004: Heterogeneity-Aware GPU Scheduling. Can capability-matched routing improve resource utilization for GPU made of deliberately non-uniform participants? by adjusting the dominant design parameter and measuring the impact on the domain metrics.

Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-012: Heterogeneity-Aware GPU Scheduling. Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-013: Decentralized GPU Scheduling. Can decentralized coordination improve resource utilization for GPU in situations where a single centralized controller cannot observe the whole system quickly enough? by adjusting the dominant design parameter and measuring the impact on the domain metrics.

Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-014: Alternative-Substrate GPU Compute Model. Would moving the cost-dominant operation of GPU onto a different physical carrier improve achievable operations per second once interface overhead is included? by adjusting the dominant design parameter and measuring the impact on the domain metrics.

Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-015: Oscillator-Synchronized GPU Compute Model. Investigate the primary engineering trade-off of: Direction DIR-016: Oscillator-Synchronized GPU Runtime Adaptation.
